papers.title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  The alignment of Small Language Models (SLMs) in the 70--500M parameter range using reinforcement learning is often considered unstable, though the underlying failure mechanisms have not been systematically investigated. In the State-of-the-Art (SOTA) research, fifteen (model, corpus) configurations were trained using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). The experiments included Pythia-70M, 160M, 410M and SmolLM2-135M, 360M on the TinyStories, CNN/DailyMail, and Wikitext-103 corpora. Three reproducible failure modes were identified in small-scale language models: silent LoRA parameter freezing in standard PEFT/TRL pipelines, numerical overflow in importance ratios when using bfloat16, and catastrophic policy collapse due to reward-model error. These issues were addressed using a merge-and-reinitialize adapter technique, float32 precision during PPO updates, and a three-layer safety mechanism comprising reward whitening, importance-ratio guarding, and weight rollback. In this paper, a capacity-headroom hypothesis is proposed, which states that PPO performance at the SLM scale depends on both a fluent supervised model (PPL<20) and a discriminative reward signal, rather than on the number of model parameters. The proposed system converged stably in all experiments and improved preference win rate over the SFT baseline in configurations with a fluent prior and an informative reward signal. Furthermore, it outperformed instruction-tuned baselines while requiring significantly less training data. All checkpoints, preference datasets, and training scripts are publicly released^§.

ru.title: Стабильное выравнивание маленьких языковых моделей через механизмы безопасности и адаптивные техники обучения
ru.desc: Статья посвящена проблеме нестабильности при обучении маленьких языковых моделей (70-500M параметров) с помощью обучения с подкреплением, в частности алгоритма PPO. Авторы систематически исследовали три основных механизма отказа: замораживание параметров LoRA, численные переполнения при использовании bfloat16 и коллапс политики из-за ошибок модели награды. Для решения этих проблем предложены специальные техники: переинициализация адаптеров, использование float32 точности и трёхслойный механизм безопасности с нормализацией награды и откатом весов. Авторы также выдвинули гипотезу о том, что успех PPO для маленьких моделей зависит от качества начальной модели и информативности сигнала награды, а не от количества параметров.

en.title: Stabilizing Small Language Models with Smart Training Techniques
en.desc: This paper investigates the challenges of aligning Small Language Models (SLMs) using reinforcement learning, particularly focusing on models with 70 to 500 million parameters. The authors identify three main failure modes that can lead to instability during training, including issues with parameter freezing and numerical overflow. To address these problems, they propose a new technique that combines adapter merging and reinitialization, along with a safety mechanism to ensure stable training. Their findings suggest that the performance of SLMs is more dependent on the quality of the supervised model and the reward signal than on the number of parameters, leading to improved training outcomes with less data.

zh.title: 小型语言模型的稳定性与强化学习的对齐
zh.desc: 本文探讨了小型语言模型（SLMs）在70到500M参数范围内使用强化学习的对齐问题，发现其不稳定性背后的机制尚未系统研究。通过使用近端策略优化（PPO）训练了十五种（模型，语料库）配置，识别出三种可重复的失败模式，包括LoRA参数冻结、bfloat16的数值溢出和奖励模型错误导致的策略崩溃。为了解决这些问题，提出了合并与重新初始化适配器技术、在PPO更新中使用float32精度，以及三层安全机制。研究还提出了一个容量余量假设，认为PPO在SLM规模上的表现依赖于流畅的监督模型和判别奖励信号，而不仅仅是模型参数的数量。
